status_inheritance: Exactly one inherited false flag changes: full-source finite-measure current, by the fixed-count BV theorem. All other inherited booleans remain unchanged. True flags record scoped manuscript proofs, not formal or independent certification.
preservation: Every inherited core, Python source, appendix and references.tex is byte-identical to the pinned v72 sibling. Exact old master, manifest and build script are in provenance. The build deterministically slices the pinned old master into its unchanged body and a compiled historical opening; all 159 old core inputs and old opening labels are retained. Exact inherited Python and appendix counts are emitted in source.preserved in the qualification evidence.
source_assembly: Run bash build.sh. Before native TeX, verify_v73.py creates build/v72-body.tex and build/v72-frontmatter.tex from provenance/v72-main.tex. No repository source is overwritten. Both generated TeX files are included in the evidence artifact.
current_scope: Theorem v73-full-source-bv proves that the complete original scalar current is a finite signed measure for every fixed m>=2, uniformly in R, epsilon and exact labels at that count. The bound C_m has uncontrolled collision-count growth. No arbitrary bounded marked or allocated subsource is asserted BV, and no total-variation convergence of arbitrary patch exhaustions is asserted.
paired_scope: For K>=2 the complete excess is bounded by the minimum of incoming positive and outgoing negative current masses near the same roof. Isolated jumps are not charged; narrow positive excursions remain. Uniform decay of this paired quantity is not proved.
path_scope: Using the inherited common positive path-remainder theorem, the ordered scalar and BL-dual path-numerator errors coincide on the original central targets. Same-roof normalization and forward essential likelihood are consequences only after scalar decay; zero arithmetic classes are not normalized. The inherited return-clock transfer is retained.
fixed_band_scope: Fix B, epsilon(B)=A0 B^(-1/12), delta(B) and reserve K=2 before m. Enlarge B only after the collision limit. The independent auxiliary B_* is fixed before m and enlarged afterwards. No count-dependent spectral estimate is used.
qualification_scope: Read-only exact-checkout source preservation, rational finite fixtures, six inherited checks, stabilized native TeX, actual recorder coverage and rendered page geometry. Passing checks are not proof certification, editorial acceptance or independent human review.
